reason: Compared the complete source definition def:generic with SM.Generic and its transitive concrete definitions. G1 quantifies every triple of pairwise distinct modular indices and requires the actual coordinate chirotope to be nonzero. G2 excludes the existence of one point of the real plane lying in the relative interiors of three pairwise-distinct indexed edge segments. edgeInterior is the image P i + t*(P(i+1)-P i) for 0<t<1, exactly the relative interior of a nondegenerate affine segment; for a degenerate segment it is its singleton, also its relative interior. On the source domain n>=3, G1 already prevents coincident vertices and duplicated geometric edges, so treating the source's distinct edge segments by their distinct indices changes no generic polygon. Generic is exactly the conjunction G1 and G2, and as a predicate on labelled tuples is the set U_n in the source; a separately named Set is unnecessary. The implementation is also defined at smaller n, which adds cases outside the source domain rather than removing source cases. It introduces no free genericity witness, extra premise or substitute abstract configuration. The global representative convention is honored by generic_shift, proved in both directions using translated indices and edgeInterior_shift; the source expressly permits this labelled-equivariance treatment instead of defining every predicate on the cyclic quotient. The reviewed semantic dependency inventory includes G1, G2, chi, det, edgeInterior, edgePoint and edge, so all geometric content is included in the statement hash. This approval is for the definition alone and does not count its supporting helpers as additional source claims.
